items.title: 56800_John Simmons oral history interview
items.q: About 12:00 here comes Oscar walking in with my bass.

ctx.x: And this solo that he made with Hawk and Eddie Heyward, 'The Man I Love', you could hear him breathing. Boy he could play. But now he's been not knowing anything about positions or tuning up or anything. He'd just pick up a bass, run his hand over it, find out where the notes was and he would hit it every time.

And the bass neck would just be gooyey from perspiration. I come to work one night, my bass wasn't there. I say 'what is this. Somebody stole my bass.' So I proceeded to get drunk. About 12:00 here comes Oscar walking in with my bass. Man, I had a record date to do and I'm sorry to have this overtime, but I couldn't get into the club to get my bass. I was so glad to get my bass, I wasn't mad or angry at him. I say

okay. And this happened again to me at Cafe Society downtown. I don't know who took the bass but they kept it all night, you know and the next night it was back on the bandstand. And I never carried any insurance on my instruments, you know.
